packageRules.description: Always the latest stable version; CI on the JDK 17 baseline is the gate
claude-code-action changes only claude.yml, which CI does not build, so there is no check to wait for: merged without one, once a week, to the commit the action's v1 tag points to
JDK versions in the workflows are deliberate: CI and `respond` build on the Java 17 baseline. They are changed by hand, never bumped.
Maven bumps through the wrapper: Renovate does not update distributionSha256Sum, so CI fails until it is set by hand (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
prBodyNotes: Update `distributionSha256Sum` in `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` to the SHA-256 of the new `apache-maven-<version>-bin.zip`, after checking the zip against Maven's published `.sha512`.

packageRules.description: Docker images in tests and scripts, found by the custom manager below; test-only, CI is the gate
PostgreSQL 18 only (owner, 2026-11-23: 19 is not ready for production): 18.x updates, never a new major

customManagers.description: Docker image tags in Java test code and shell scripts (the Testcontainers images and the JPMS smoke test); ignorePaths above replaces config:recommended's, which skips every test folder
